section: Protected areas of Andhra Pradesh - national parks, sanctuaries, tiger reserve and Ramsar sites

accepted.s: Which one of the following correctly describes the change in the prescribed approach to the extent of eco-sensitive zones around protected areas?
o: The 2002–16 Wildlife Action Plan suggested 10 km, while the Supreme Court prescribed a minimum of 1 km in June 2022.
The 2002–16 Wildlife Action Plan prescribed a minimum of 10 km, while the Supreme Court reduced it to 1 km in June 2022.
The 2002–16 Wildlife Action Plan suggested 1 km, while the Supreme Court prescribed a minimum of 10 km in June 2022.
Both the Wildlife Action Plan and the Supreme Court prescribed a uniform 10 km eco-sensitive zone.
accepted.x: The 2002–16 Wildlife Action Plan suggested a 10 km zone around protected areas. In June 2022, the Supreme Court made a minimum 1 km eco-sensitive zone mandatory.
accepted.tq: Discriminate between two similar distances and their respective authorities.

accepted.s: With reference to final eco-sensitive zone notifications in India, which one of the following combinations is correct?
o: 353 notifications covering 688 of 496 protected areas
353 notifications covering 496 of 688 protected areas
496 notifications covering 353 of 688 protected areas
688 notifications covering 496 of 353 protected areas
accepted.x: There are 353 final eco-sensitive zone notifications covering 496 out of 688 protected areas nationally.
accepted.tq: Split the numerical options into notification count, protected-area count and coverage count.

accepted.s: Which of the following current developments was associated with the Nagarjuna-Srisailam Tiger Reserve in June 2026?
o: The permanent closure of all forest routes for tourism
The declaration of a new Ramsar site
A monsoon ban on safari vehicles
A proposal to establish a satellite launch facility
accepted.x: A monsoon ban on safari vehicles in the Nagarjuna-Srisailam Tiger Reserve was reported in June 2026.
accepted.tq: Use the date and event together to identify the correct current-affairs association.

accepted.s: A survey reported on 1 May 2026 in the Nagarjuna-Srisailam Tiger Reserve concerned which of the following?
o: The peacock tarantula
The Indian pangolin
The Malabar giant squirrel
The Indian peafowl
accepted.x: The survey in the Nagarjuna-Srisailam Tiger Reserve on 1 May 2026 concerned the peacock tarantula.
accepted.tq: Apply precise species discrimination to a current wildlife-survey question.

accepted.s: Which of the following correctly describes the environmental concern associated with Hope Island near Coringa?
o: Threat from a proposed satellite launch facility
Threat from the expansion of safari vehicle routes
Threat from the construction of a new tiger reserve headquarters
Threat from the notification of a 10 km eco-sensitive zone
accepted.x: Hope Island near Coringa was reported to face a threat from a satellite launch facility.
accepted.tq: Identify the development project linked to the specified ecological threat.

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements regarding notified forest area in Andhra Pradesh:
1. The notified forest area was 37,421.11 sq km in 2025–26.
2. The notified forest area constituted 22.96% of the State’s area in 2025–26.
3. In 2024–25, the corresponding figures were 37,221.11 sq km and 22.84%.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
o: 1, 2 and 3
1 and 2 only
2 and 3 only
1 and 3 only
accepted.x: All three statements are correct. Andhra Pradesh had 37,421.11 sq km of notified forest, or 22.96%, in 2025–26; the earlier figures were 37,221.11 sq km and 22.84%.
accepted.tq: Check each numerical statement independently before selecting the combined option.
